name: Palomino Exchange
summary: The Palomino Exchange is a simple transactional arrangement handled by the horse breeders of Elwynn Forest. It allows riders who acquire an old palomino bridle to trade it in for an updated mount suitable for travel across the kingdom.

sections.title: Equine Trade in Elwynn
sections.body: Elwynn Forest serves as the heart of equestrian life for the kingdom of Stormwind. Between Eastvale Logging Camp and the farmlands of Goldshire, stable hands and horse breeders care for thoroughbreds that carry messengers, town guards, and travelling adventurers along the King's Road. The palomino exchange reflects standard stable upkeep, offering riders the chance to update their bridles and mounts through the local horse handlers.

sections.title: A Matter of Stock
sections.body: The stables across Azeroth have seen fluctuating supplies of horses since the ravages of the Third War. As the royal cavalry reorganizes and standardizes its gear, stable masters honor old claims and trade agreements, swapping out older palomino bridles for horses conditioned for long-distance road riding.

faq.answer: It is a practical exchange offered by stable masters in Elwynn Forest, allowing a rider with an older Palomino Bridle to turn it in for standard equine stock.

faq.q: Where does this trade take place?
aliases: where do i turn in palomino
faq.answer: The exchange is handled by the horse breeders operating out of the pastures and stables in Elwynn Forest, primarily around Eastvale Logging Camp.

faq.q: Why do the stables exchange palominos?
faq.answer: Stable masters maintain uniform stock and gear for travelers and military couriers across the Alliance, swapping out retired equipment and older steeds for standardized mounts.

faq.q: Do I need special standing with Stormwind to ride a palomino?
faq.answer: Humans are naturally trained in riding these steeds, while other Alliance races must earn the trust and goodwill of Stormwind before purchasing and handling their horses.

faq.q: Is the palomino a common military mount?
faq.answer: While heavy pinto and armored chargers often accompany knightly detachments, palominos are prized primarily for swift travel, scouting, and dependable road passage throughout the southern kingdoms.

faq.q: Does this involve exotic magical beasts?
faq.answer: No. The palomino is an ordinary, well-bred mortal steed raised through patient animal husbandry in the fertile meadows of Elwynn.

angles.text: The horse breeders of Elwynn take pride in their stock, providing their fellow humans with swift and reliable mounts suited for patrols along the kingdom's borders.
Stables throughout Elwynn supply the backbone of Alliance courier and ground transit across Azeroth's southern territories.
